_comment: All dimensions in mm. Door hook with platform for a portable projector.
_front_lip_height: How far the front wall drops down from the top of the door.
_back_lip_height: How far the back wall drops down from the top of the door.
_platform_length: How far the platform sticks out from the front wall into the room.
_platform_thickness: Vertical thickness of the platform shelf.
_gap_clearance: Extra gap added to door_thickness so the clip slides on easily.
